gizmo.title: Tuhipoka
gizmo.description: He tuhipoka i tuhia ki te wāhi e tika ai i te kuputuhi. Ka whakaaturia hei tau, ā, ka hanga aunoa te rārangi tuhipoka kua tauhia ki te pito o te whārangi.

configure.title: Kāore he arokite
configure.description: Kaua e whakaatu i te tuhipoka ina tau te kiore a te kaipānui ki runga i te tau, ina arotahia rānei.
